verdict.rationale: The Department documents its own bulk mechanisms. Agents with 100 or more clients can use a batch enrollment file to add or delete clients, and there is an electronic file-and-pay program for large reemployment-tax data files with a published XML schema package. The scope is narrow, though: batch enrollment only covers adding and deleting clients, applies only above the 100-client threshold, and its technical specifications are available only by email request. Missing for 10: openly published batch specifications, bulk updates and other bulk actions beyond client add/delete, a programmatic or API surface for bulk operations, and independent or hands-on confirmation that batch processing works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: If an agent has 100 or more clients to add or delete, the agent may use a batch enrollment file.
The Department has established an electronic file and pay program for entities submitting large data files with reemployment tax information.
Download the Reemployment Tax XML Package
